entities.name: Bacterial uS13
observations: The 121-aa query exactly matches reviewed UniProt uS13 O50632 (100% identity and coverage; E-value 6.36e-76).
uS13 is a 30S ribosomal protein contacting 16S rRNA; in the 70S ribosome it participates in intersubunit bridges and contacts A- and P-site tRNAs, based on reviewed reference annotation.
Pfam Ribosomal_S13 (PF00416.28) is detected at residues 3–108 (i-Evalue 3.9e-34).
Sequence-derived estimates: molecular mass 13,794.7 Da; pI 11.20; GRAVY −0.748; charge at pH 7 +14.61.
